message: 人として生きられる幸せ

name: Synn
message: 「Today's flash sale was pretty disappointing~」

name: Paqy
message: 「Caviar comes in jars and keeps for a long time. Can't be helped.」

name: Synn
message: 「I can't afford caviar!」
Oh...? That figure from behind is...

name: Synn
message: 「Riesliiiing!」

name: Synn
message: 「Eek!」

name: Riesling
message: 「Please excuse me.」

name: Synn
message: 「A-Are you out shopping?」

name: Riesling
message: 「Yes. I went to Capricore to procure today's catch.」

name: Synn
message: 「Catch, you say?」

name: Paqy
message: 「Oh, oh. Is that the scent of caviar I smell!?」

name: Synn
message: 「It's sealed in a jar, there's no way you can smell it.」

name: Riesling
message: 「It is a roe-bearing sturgeon.」
True to calling it a catch, it's raw.

name: Synn
message: 「Dinner at the Rosenkreuz household really is on another level.」

name: Riesling
message: 「You flatter me.」

name: Synn
message: 「Ah, today... Lolotte mentioned she might be running late...」

name: Riesling
message: 「I have already received word of that.」

name: Riesling
message: 「...Is something the matter?」

name: Synn
message: 「Ah, no! It's just that Lolotte seemed even more fired up than usual, so, well...」

name: Riesling
message: 「Please speak honestly.」

name: Synn
message: 「Ahaha...\s02 Well, lately... Lolotte has been getting home really late...」

name: Synn
message: 「Is everything okay with her family? Are they really strict after all...」

name: Riesling
message: 「You are concerned for Milady's well-being, are you not?」

name: Synn
message: 「W-Well, there's that too, but... um... you're her chaperone, Riesling-san, so...」

name: Synn
message: 「If Lolotte's parents have been giving you a hard time... um... if there's anything I can do...」

name: Riesling
message: 「Please rest assured. Both the Master and the Mistress understand.」

name: Riesling
message: 「Milady has always been a very curious person by nature, so both of them say it is best to let her do as she pleases as much as possible.」

name: Synn
message: 「I-Is that so」

name: Riesling
message: 「However, Milady is kind. She must have been holding herself back all this time.」

name: Synn
message: 「Holding herself back...?」

name: Riesling
message: 「So as not to cause them too much worry... you see.」

name: Synn
message: 「Th-Then! Does that mean she's fine with worrying them now...? And that's why she joined the Student Council too...!」

name: Riesling
message: 「It seems you are being overly modest.」

name: Synn
message: 「Huh?」

name: Riesling
message: 「Milady likely thought, 'If I am with the members of the Student Council, I will be safe.'」

name: Synn
message: 「With... us...」

name: Riesling
message: 「Do you not think she believed that with everyone in the Student Council, she would not cause her parents any worry?」

name: Synn
message: 「I-I kind of feel like we've been walking on pretty thin ice ourselves, though...」

name: Riesling
message: 「Please hold your head high.」
Riesling-san presses her fist against my chest.

name: Riesling
message: 「Inside the academy is beyond the jurisdiction of even I, Riesling Toyama. The only one who can protect Milady is you, President.」

name: Riesling
message: 「I ask that you continue to look after Milady from here on out.」

name: Synn
message: 「Y-Yes, ma'am!」
Riesling-san is so cool...
Everything about her way of life and demeanor is utterly captivating.
Life experiences completely beyond my ken must have made her the way she is.

name: Riesling
message: 「Now then, please excuse me.」

name: Riesling
message: 「Is there something else?」

name: Synn
message: 「Riesling-san, why do you work as a butler?」

name: Riesling
message: 「That is--」

name: Riesling
message: 「Because the human heart that resides within me tells me to devote myself to my young lady.」
